understanding.output_contract: Structured problem; absent required fields omitted and listed as sorted full paths in missing_information
understanding.applicability: Known problem family, task text and output field definitions; incomplete data permitted
understanding.instruction: Extract the optimization problem using the statement AND supplement. Return only a JSON object. field_contract.empty_output defines allowed fields, not mandatory placeholders: omit any required field not supplied by the input and list its sorted full path in missing_information. Never retain an empty placeholder for a missing parameter. Read field_contract.rules. Keep entity_order. objective is a STRING: minimize or maximize. Respect explicit integer or continuous variable requirements; do not infer integer solely from an object name. Always include missing_information (empty array when nothing is missing). No code, no extra keys.

method.output_contract: method_id, condition_ids, explanation; or missing_fields without a guessed method
method.applicability: Check model structure and candidate conditions; incomplete required data prevents selection in this demo
method.instruction: Choose an applicable method by comparing the problem with candidate conditions and operations; a listed candidate is not necessarily applicable. Return {"method_id": string, "condition_ids": [string], "explanation": string}. Use exact identifiers from the selected card. Explain the model condition that justifies the method, not performance superiority. If problem.missing_information is nonempty, return only {"missing_fields": [string]} with those paths.

call.output_contract: tool_name and arguments; or missing_fields with no tool execution
call.applicability: Known selected method and compatible interface for complete data; partial data produces a request for information
call.instruction: Build a tool call from problem and context. Return exactly {"tool_name": string, "arguments": {"objective": string, "entities": array, "units": object, "parameters": object}}. Copy the problem parameters without changing their meaning or order. Use context.tool_name. If required information is missing, return only {"missing_fields": [string]} instead. Do not compute an answer or generate Python.

result.output_contract: status, objective_value, values, optimality_proven, next_action, explanation
result.applicability: Complete problem and a real tool return; no fabricated return when unavailable
result.instruction: Interpret actual_return, not an imagined solution. Return exactly {"status": string, "objective_value": number or null, "values": array or null, "optimality_proven": boolean, "next_action": string, "explanation": string}. Preserve its status, objective_value and values. Choose next_action from status_definitions. Only optimal means optimality_proven=true. For infeasible do not invent a solution. Explain briefly.

roles.evidence: source and independent verification; not inserted into prompts
